shortBulletSummary: Geopolitical tensions surge in the Middle East, boosting oil prices over $100 and fueling inflation fears across global markets.
Bitcoin drops nearly 2% as spot ETFs experience $225 million in net outflows, breaking a recent positive streak.
Ethereum ETFs draw $26.3 million in inflows, achieving their 5th consecutive positive day.
Delays and legislative hurdles with the US CLARITY Act create ongoing regulatory uncertainty for crypto markets.
The Crypto Fear & Greed Index stands at 42, indicating neutral market sentiment despite recent price drops.
